card.text: Explore Cordelia, the inner shepherd of Uranus's epsilon ring.

introduction.text: Cordelia travels just inside Uranus’s bright epsilon ring. Its gravity helps confine the ring’s inner edge, while Voyager observations constrain the moon’s elongated shape.

model.title: Shape approximation
model.summary: A 50 × 36 × 36 km shape estimate from Voyager. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no surface imagery.
